detailZones.title: CT bay
detailZones.description: Inspect the CT gantry, aperture, couch, control details and the adjacent wash area.

detailZones.title: MRI bay
detailZones.description: Locate the magnet and head cradle, then follow the patient couch toward the separate console behind the glass.

detailZones.title: X-ray and mammography
detailZones.description: Inspect the radiography room, mammography assembly, X-ray tube and detector hardware.

detailZones.title: Control room
detailZones.description: Study the workstation, desk, monitor, chair, console keypad and glass control partition.

detailZones.title: Ultrasound bay
detailZones.description: Find the blue-capped gel bottle next to the ultrasound controls, then compare the wheels under the cart and couch.

detailZones.title: Preparation and supplies
detailZones.description: Find the hooked IV pole and supply cart, the garments on their rail and the sink in front of the cabinets.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source illustration distinguishes the ultrasound monitor, console, squeeze bottle, hanging cable and two separate sets of casters. The CT, MRI, mammography and X-ray equipment, glazed control desk and foreground supplies have separate image regions. Vocabulary for parts and functions that the illustration cannot distinguish is kept in related words.
